raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Implements the ownership and reload lifecycle in #57895. Part of #53343; split from #53344.

PWAL can produce a correct temporary tensor and then restore a graph-captured allocation containing the previous value. Helpers may also keep aliases to discarded temporary storage. Source-dropping model transforms additionally need the current checkpoint weights to remain available until packing completes.

## Changes

- Declare semantic derived buffers, preserve None/late schemas, and distinguish derived state from static and protocol buffers.
- Materialize once; validate shape/dtype/device and update existing storage in place.
- Preserve first derived allocations produced during reload; commit PWAL-produced values before stable placement.
- Run quant/module preparation hooks before any meta placement, so unsupported reload can fail before changing weight storage.
- Stage opted-in source modules until their owner/parent process_weights_for_reload() consumes checkpoint values and releases sources; then restore stable runtime storage.
- Add common publishing and helper binding/rebinding without a hard-coded MoE namespace.
- Dispatch post_weights_reload() only after all primary storage and deferred attention are final, children before parents and quant methods before module hooks.
- Retain existing CUTLASS W4A8, FlashInfer CUTLASS/B12x and TRT-LLM FP8/MXFP4 consumers as integration examples.

Source-dropping representations use staged transform/copy-back. Recomputable secondary state uses completion from final weights. A materialized cache does not prove freshness.

## Independent follow-ups and merge order

Merge this core PR first. All follow-up branches start from main and contain only their own changes; no PR is stacked on an unmerged PR.

Suggested order: #58991 (GLM), #58992 (Kimi MLA), #59003 (MegaMoE), #58995 (broadcast), #58999 (ROCm), #58996 (CPU), #59002 (FlashInfer alphas), #59001 (vision), #59000 (Gemma MTP), #53510 (Humming), then #53511 (Lamport). Unrelated model migrations can merge in another order after the core. Full scope and prerequisites are tracked in #57895.

This assigns all model/backend modifications from aoshen02/vllm#56. The core PR is updated in place. #49789 (ReloadArena), #55595 (selective FP8 reload), and #57733 (cold traversal) are related approaches, not duplicated here.

## Boundaries

This supplies lifecycle/storage primitives, not selective reload eligibility or support. A future #54477 dispatcher can call completion after refresh_derived_state(). Wake protocol state stays in #53510/#53511. Opaque FlashInfer packed weights remain unsupported for reload; #59002 only owns explicit alphas and rejects unsafe reload. The CUDA Graph oracle is a separate validation follow-up.

## Validation

Regressions cover repeated updates, stable pointers and values, source-dropping transforms, late/lazy schemas, first materialization, helper aliases, layout rejection, ordered completion, deferred attention, and preparation failure before meta placement.

Rebased onto upstream main. Locally passed on the full PR diff: Ruff lint/format, Python compileall, git diff --check, test-tether checks, and DCO/sign-off auditing.

Windows pytest collection is blocked by missing uvloop; no runtime pass is claimed. Full pre-commit setup previously failed downloading a shellcheck dependency. Linux/backend integration and CUDA Graph replay remain pending. No H20 or remote GPU validation was run.

## AI assistance

AI assistance was used for design refinement, code, and static checks. Human review and runtime validation remain pending.

+def register_derived_buffer(layer: torch.nn.Module, name: str) -> None:
+    """Declare a non-persistent buffer whose value is derived from weights.
+
+    The placeholder records the module schema before the first weight load. The
+    first call to :func:`set_derived_buffer` installs storage; subsequent calls
+    update that storage in place so CUDA graph references remain valid.
+    """
+    if name in layer._buffers:
+        raise KeyError(f"Buffer {name!r} is already registered")
+    layer.register_buffer(name, None, persistent=False)
+    names = getattr(layer, "_vllm_derived_buffers", None)
+    if names is None:
+        names = layer._vllm_derived_buffers = set()
+    names.add(name)

+        raise KeyError(f"Derived buffer {name!r} is not registered")

+    if existing is None:

+

+        or existing.dtype != value.dtype
+        or existing.device != value.device

+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Cannot update derived buffer {name!r}: "
+            f"existing={existing.shape}/{existing.dtype}/{existing.device}, "
+            f"new={value.shape}/{value.dtype}/{value.device}. "
